podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 2001, despite never reaching number one on the weekly Hot 100 chart. It is cited as the "ultimate example of what Billboard critics would later call mini van rock"—unhip, Top 40-friendly post-grunge that acted as "glue for radio at the turn of the millennium." The Malibu band secured the title through its sheer persistence and radio friendliness, staying on the Hot 100 for over a year. "Hanging by a moment never reached number one in any week but proved so radio friendly it hung on to the hot 100 more than a year."
